common.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark mode

web.label: Public website
web.headline: Stuck on the road? Get help fast.
web.body: Share your location and problem, get quotes with price and arrival time from verified providers nearby, and pick the one you want.

provider.label: Provider portal
provider.headline: Get roadside jobs near you.
provider.body: See requests in your area, send a quote with your price and arrival time, and get paid directly by the driver.

admin.label: Admin dashboard
admin.headline: Run every market from one place.
admin.body: Launch markets, verify providers, and manage pricing, fees and plans.

errors.invalid: Check your email and password and try again.
errors.code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't available in this environment yet.
errors.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.

admin.title: Admin sign-in
admin.subtitle: Staff only. You'll confirm with your authenticator app next.
admin.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.enrollBody: Admin accounts need a second step. Scan this code with an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
admin.noAccessBody: Your account isn't set up as staff. Ask a super admin to add you.

provider.title: Provider sign-in
provider.subtitle: Sign in with your password or get a sign-in link by email.
provider.linkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link. It expires in 1 hour.
provider.phoneBody: We text a 6-digit code to the phone drivers and dispatch will reach you on.
